landingSubtitle: Discover and create unique color recipes for your Sony Alpha camera, powered by AI.
quizResultDescription: Based on your answers, we think you'll love this recipe:
recipeDetailWelcomeText: Explore color recipes visually. Select a recipe from the list or the chart to see details.
ctaText: Love this recipe? Share your photos on the Sony Alpha Vietnam | Official Facebook group with hashtags #sonycolorlab and {recipeHashtag} for a chance to be featured!
aiLabDescription: Describe the style you want, and Gemini will tweak the {recipeName} recipe for you.
aiPromptPlaceholder: E.g., a clean, slightly teal look like a Wes Anderson film...
aiConfirmPromptText: Got it! I will generate a new version of {recipeName} with a style inspired by "{userPrompt}". Shall we proceed?
aiComparisonDescription: Here is the new version based on your request. Changed parameters are highlighted.
aiErrorText: Sorry, the recipe could not be generated at this time. Please check your API Key or try again later.
saveGuideSubtitle: Using the Camera Setting Memory feature on Alpha cameras with the new menu.
aiQuizPromptPlaceholder: e.g., a sunset afternoon in Dalat, cinematic tone, a bit melancholic...
aiQuizResultDescription: Here is the unique recipe created based on your inspiration:
quizSubmitInfo: Tap to discover the color recipe made just for you.
contributeNoteText:
To have your photo featured as a recipe demo, please:
1. Shoot using the exact parameters of the original recipe.
2. Upload to the album and comment with the color code (e.g., SCL-001) on your photo.
logInToComment: Log in to leave a comment.
logInToSave: You need to log in to save recipes.
logInToViewFavorites: Please log in to see your saved recipes.
noFavoritesYet: You haven't saved any recipes yet. Explore and save the colors you love!
noCommentsYet: No comments yet. Be the first!
noGeneratedRecipes: You haven't generated any recipes with AI yet.
noDemoPhotos: You haven't contributed any demo photos yet.
howToContributeDescription: Your photo could be featured in the main gallery! Please follow these steps:
contributeStep1: Upload your photo to a sharing service (e.g., Google Photos, Flickr) and get a public link.
contributeStep2: Fill out the photo link and required information in the form.
contributeStep3: Photos will be reviewed before being displayed publicly. Thank you for your contribution!
photoUrlHint: Make sure the link is publicly accessible.
accountExists: An account already exists with a different credential.
